parameters.query:
SELECT
    run_id,
    pipeline_name,
    started_at,
    finished_at,
    status,
    rows_processed,
    error_message
FROM pipeline_runs
WHERE run_id = {{ $json.run_id }};

SELECT
    external_order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count,
    MIN(order_ts) AS first_seen,
    MAX(order_ts) AS last_seen
FROM orders
WHERE external_order_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY external_order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY duplicate_count DESC;

SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.external_order_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.unit_price AS expected_price,
    o.unit_price AS observed_price,
    ROUND(
        ((o.unit_price - p.unit_price)
        / NULLIF(p.unit_price, 0)) * 100,
        2
    ) AS price_deviation_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN products p
    ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE ABS(o.unit_price - p.unit_price)
      > p.unit_price * 0.50
ORDER BY ABS(o.unit_price - p.unit_price) DESC;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE source IS NULL
    ) AS missing_source_orders,
    ROUND(
        100.0 *
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source IS NULL)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS missing_source_pct
FROM orders
WHERE order_ts::date = DATE '2026-09-28';

parameters.query:
UPDATE orders
SET is_quarantined = TRUE
WHERE order_id IN (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM (
        SELECT
            order_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY external_order_id
                ORDER BY order_id
            ) AS rn
        FROM orders
        WHERE external_order_id = 'DEMO-ANOM-20260928-DUP'
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn > 1
)
RETURNING
    order_id,
    external_order_id,
    is_quarantined;
